implementation.sessionSeam: Reuse same-tab gf_access_token; refresh through the existing CRM httpOnly cookie; validate via CRM /api/v4/auth/me; pass that bearer to the existing Post getServerSession guard.
implementation.authorization: Require the existing CRM admin role for the approval write. Existing Post validation still binds the request to one candidate_id, one immutable approved PublicationPlan snapshot, exact content, and one Fansly destination.

cases: No bearer token returns 401 before any CRM request.
An authenticated non-admin CRM identity returns 403 before the approval write.
The existing admin identity contract can approve only the exact candidate and matching immutable snapshot; CRM receives the same candidate ID and idempotency key.
The session adapter validates bearer identity through the existing CRM /api/v4/auth/me endpoint.
proof.limitation: No live CRM bearer token or selected production candidate was available in this execution environment; no durable operator approval decision or external Fansly publication was written. This is focused integration proof against the existing /auth/me response contract.

adjudication.productPolicy: An authenticated existing authorized operator pressing the heart approves only that exact immutable candidate/plan. It grants no authority for another candidate, destination, changed plan, or future automatic publication.
